stills.caption: The day's first visit to town: the mod's script has already mailed today's letter, so there is mail waiting at the house.
Taken from the mailbox, it is a letter to you from "A friend", sent with the send_letter command.
The letter is the mod's own text, from its messages file, with a little present attached.

film.caption: Walking up to the mailbox, taking out the Daily Gift letter and reading it.
